## [1.4.0](https://github.com/bin0culars/bin0culars-patches/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0) (2026-11-10)

### ✨ New Features

* **reddit:** bin0culars mods link at the top of the community menu ([#20](https://github.com/bin0culars/bin0culars-patches/issues/20)) ([c0b3121](https://github.com/bin0culars/bin0culars-patches/commit/c0b3121a6cbce77382097e1bc651698e2f5db9e7))
* **reddit:** content-type filter for Home and Popular ([#18](https://github.com/bin0culars/bin0culars-patches/issues/18)) ([b7c8a97](https://github.com/bin0culars/bin0culars-patches/commit/b7c8a97ab18acc2e4cb93d6df2041ac48ba49e10))

patches.name: Account switcher private mode
patches.description: Lets you choose whether the account switcher offers Anonymous Browsing or Incognito, even with one account. Choose in Settings → bin0culars mods.

patches.name: Content-type filter
patches.description: Show only videos, images, text or link posts on Home and Popular.

patches.name: Post side panel
patches.description: On tablets in landscape, opens posts in a panel on the right while the feed stays visible. Can be turned off in Settings → bin0culars mods.

patches.name: Tablet grid feed
patches.description: Shows the feed as a grid with 2 or 3 columns on tablets and other wide screens. Phones are unchanged.
